target: The unchanged 33-state/25-source bank target and frozen teacher Q_A moment. Later native actions are natural in the estimand, not in every measurement path.
measurement: G_future=0.5 P_future+0.5 T_future on the complete stopped continuation. Sample one component per path. T tilts the nearest two BVs at each later pre-draw state using P*clearance_risk^4 and unchanged correlated natural conditional partners. No initial action or initial partner tilt.
weight: P_future/G_future evaluated using both path densities, including on natural-component paths; weight <=2. Moment observations use Y*(P_future/G_future) ONCE, multiplied by the action stratum coefficient C_h. Do not square this future weight.
budget: Same frozen v2 equal partition/counts: 256 roots/state/arm/batch, 33792 logical continuations. Natural-component paths are simulated once and shared with the natural control. Component assignments, actions and seeds locked before outcomes. No extra batches or outcome-dependent extensions.
uncertainty: Two-sided bounded empirical Bernstein intervals, Bonferroni over states/strata/arms/batches. Weighted events are not Bernoulli; no Clopper-Pearson interval for weighted values. Variance ratios descriptive only; retain all zero and event sources.
scope: Training-only estimator development, not a transferable state model, production Q, population efficiency test or PPO launch. Consumed validation/final test data remain unopened.
